svg.text: Reliable queues and persistent streams on one replicated log · exactly-once from the MVP · as of 27 Oct 2026
TCP + TLS 1.3 · length-prefixed binary frames · versions per API key (ApiVersions) · mTLS + SASL (SCRAM-SHA-512, OAUTHBEARER) · smart clients go to the leader, NOT_LEADER redirects
Broker node — one process per node (lotse-server), core logic sans-I/O
Plugins on the same core API
Shared log engine — one log for queues and streams
Raft log = partition log, no separate WAL
Immutable once closed · varint-delta records · zstd / lz4 on the record block
Acks, delivery counts, timers and txn markers are records too
Own sans-I/O Raft core, one group per partition / queue / priority level; batched per node pair
Quorum 2 of 3 · snapshots = state + segment references (no data copy)
Clock · Disk · Net · Spawn · Rng as traits — Tokio in production (lotse-broker), seeded deterministic simulation with fault injection in tests (lotse-sim)
No network hops in the data path
Adapter layer for AMQP / Kafka later
lotse-rt seam keeps the core testable
